verses.candidateRo: Pentru copilul acesta mă rugam, și DOMNUL a ascultat rugăciunea pe care I-o făceam.
verses.WEBU: I prayed for this child, and the LORD has given me my petition which I asked of him.
verses.WLC: אֶל־הַנַּ֥עַר הַזֶּ֖ה הִתְפַּלָּ֑לְתִּי וַיִּתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֥ה לִי֙ אֶת־שְׁאֵ֣לָתִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁאַ֖לְתִּי מֵעִמּֽוֹ׃

verses.candidateRo: „De aceea vreau să-l dau DOMNULUI: toată viața lui să fie dat DOMNULUI.”
verses.WEBU: Therefore I have also given him to the LORD. As long as he lives he is given to the LORD.” He worshiped the LORD there.
verses.WLC: וְגַ֣ם אָנֹכִ֗י הִשְׁאִלְתִּ֙הוּ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה כָּל־הַיָּמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֔ה ה֥וּא שָׁא֖וּל לַֽיהוָ֑ה וַיִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ שָׁ֖ם לַיהוָֽה׃ פ
